field_descriptions.steeringAngleDeg: Steering wheel angle, degrees. Positive = right turn.
field_descriptions.steeringTorque_driver: Driver-applied torque, native CAN units. Positive = right. Measured by column torque sensor.
field_descriptions.steeringTorqueEps: EPS motor output torque, native CAN units. Reflects actual power steering assist.
field_descriptions.latActive: True when openpilot lateral (steering) control is engaged.
field_descriptions.cmd_torque_norm: OP's desired torque command, normalized -1.0 (full left) to +1.0 (full right).
field_descriptions.cmd_torqueOutputCan: OP steering command scaled to CAN value, before vehicle rate-limit clamping.
field_descriptions.actual_torque_norm: Torque command after car-specific rate limits applied, normalized.
field_descriptions.actual_torqueOutputCan: CAN value actually transmitted to the EPS after all constraints.
